subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: **CAUSTIC**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Sarcastic**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Caustic"** means sarcastic in a scathing and bitter way, or capable of burning, corroding, or destroying organic tissue by chemical action. (तीखा, कटु, या जलाने वाला)
 
 
• **Example:** Her caustic comments about his work left him feeling insulted.
 
 
• **"Sarcastic"** refers to using irony to mock or convey contempt. (व्यंग्यात्मक)
 
 
• **Example:** He made a sarcastic remark about her punctuality, knowing she was always late.
 
 
• Hence, the word "caustic" aligns closely with "sarcastic" in terms of its meaning.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Sarcastic**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Kind** (दयालु): Having or showing a friendly, generous, and considerate nature.
 
 
• **Example:** She is always kind to animals and takes care of stray dogs.
 
 

 
• **Mild** (हल्का): Not severe, serious, or harsh.
 
 
• **Example:** The weather today is mild, perfect for a picnic.
 
 

 
• **Gentle** (कोमल): Having or showing a mild, kind, or tender temperament.
 
 
• **Example:** He gave her a gentle push to signal that it was her turn to speak.
 
 

34:T99e,

The correct answer is: **Option 3**.
